 4                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Senator 

 5   DeFrancisco.

 6                SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:   Thank you.  

 7                In view of the time in this 

 8   legislative session, with so much going on, I 

 9   haven't asked for the resolution to be read.  But 

10   this is a very important resolution, and we have 

11   guests in the room concerning this.

12                Yesterday we passed this resolution 

13   which basically calls on the Governor to declare 

14   July 19th to 25th of this year as Arteriovenous 

15   Malformation Awareness Week in New York State.  

16   It's sometimes known as AVM.  

17                And AVM is defined as an abnormal 

18   connection between arteries and veins which 

19   bypass the capillary system.  AVM is a rare 

20   condition that affects approximately 300,000 

21   Americans.  And one such American is here today, 

22   Kelleigh Gustafson, with her parents and her 

23   physician, Dr. Eric DeShaies.  

24                It's a very difficult condition.  

25   She's had it since she was 4 years old.  Could 


                                                                3603

 1   you just stand, Kelleigh?  Absolutely beautiful 

 2   woman that goes through very difficult times 

 3   because of this condition.  

 4                And she started an organization 

 5   called Kelleigh's Cause when they lived in 

 6   Michigan.  Now they live in Central New York, and 

 7   I'm very proud of that.  And she wants people to 

 8   at least know about this disease and start 

 9   spreading the word so that there can be more 

10   research about the disease.  

11                Kelleigh's Cause was founded in 

12   Michigan, as I mentioned, since she was diagnosed 

13   with this when she was 4 years old.  What it does 

14   is it affected her right side of her head, neck 

15   and chest at 4 years old.  

16                And people should know about this 

17   disease in order so that we can get rid of it.  

18   The problem is there's so few inflicted with it, 

19   there's not that big cause out there.  

20                Well, this is going to be a big 

21   cause with Kelleigh.  She's dedicated to it, she 

22   is clearly motivated to make people know about 

23   the disease so we can help her and many others 

24   like her.
